findings.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Collection filters omit SQS exception events and include a regression fixture whose telemetry does not match its profile label.
3 open issues - [Include SQS error test in AWS 1.11 collection profile](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20649#discussion_r4300806011) · New - [Exclude SqsProcessMetricsIsolationTest from collection variant](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20649#discussion_r4300806028) · New - [Include default-propagator SQS error test in AWS 2.2 profile](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20649#discussion_r4300806045) · New
Review effort: Balanced

[Testing] Restricting this task to `S3ClientTest` excludes the inherited `SqsTracingTest.testDeleteMessageError`, which emits `messaging.settle.exception` in logs mode. S3 exercises `rpc.client.call.exception`, and no other collected AWS 1.11 task enables exception logs, so the generated event inventory omits the SQS event. Include the SQS error test in this profile.

[Testing] This collected profile also selects `internal.SqsProcessMetricsIsolationTest`. That regression fixture enables and disables receive telemetry independently of this task and never enables experimental attributes. Its `waitAndAssertMetrics(...)` calls therefore collect telemetry under the wrong profile label, including metrics from the synthetic `test-camel` scope. Exclude this fixture from the collection variant, as required by `instrumentation-docs/readme.md:52,64-67`; it remains covered by the baseline `test` task.

[Testing] This filter excludes the inherited `Aws2SqsDefaultPropagatorTest.testDeleteMessageError` from the logs JVM. That operation emits `messaging.settle.exception`, which the selected `Aws2ClientTest` does not exercise. No other collected AWS 2.2 profile enables exception logs, so the generated event inventory omits the SQS event. Include the default-propagator SQS error test here.

Collect exception-log metadata for AWS SDK 1.11, AWS SDK 2.2, and OkHttp 3.0.

Organize AWS library tests into default and named opt-in profiles corresponding to the javaagent variants. Test selection stays fixed when metadata collection is enabled.

Label programmatically configured library profiles with builder calls, not agent properties that do not configure the library. Keep genuine shared properties such as `otel.semconv.exception.signal.preview=logs` as property conditions, and document this distinction in collection and agent guidance.

For OkHttp, register the baseline exception-log task without adding equivalent library-version variants or `logs/dup` collection.
metadata.title: Collect exception-log metadata for AWS SDK and OkHttp
